CAPTURED, NOT WRITTEN. `busctl tree org.bluealsa` on the office wall panel,
2026-09-19, BlueALSA v4.1.1 started as `bluealsa -S -p a2dp-sink -p hfp-hf`,
with the dev PC connected as a gateway.

This file exists because the test that was supposed to pin the object path fed
the parser an INVENTED `sco/sink` string -- the same spelling the parser was
written against -- so it agreed with itself and could not fail. v4 names the
middle segment after the PROFILE (`hfphf`, `a2dpsnk`), not the transport, and
the shipped regex matched nothing on a real panel for as long as it shipped.

The address below is the dev PC's and is replaced with a documentation value;
the SHAPE is what is under test and the shape is verbatim.

└─ /org
  ├─ /org/bluealsa

  │     ├─ /org/bluealsa/hci0/dev_AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF/hfphf
